graph_origin: Importer-assigned named graphs, not upstream named graphs; no entailment.
source_mapping: Wikidata original selected direct claims and labels; GeoNames original CSV rows through existing Schema.org mapper; GEMET original concept fields/relations. Overlay triples are separately serialized synthetic adversarial annotations, never upstream claims.
gold_provenance: AI-authored questions and interpretation references; full bindings/witnesses computed model-free from frozen source triples. Deterministic source audit is not independent semantic review.
split_rule: Separate university, city/region and focal GEMET concept resource lineages; all paraphrases/translations of an instantiated intent stay in its split. Shared task families, source archives and ontology vocabulary are deliberate; not independent expert or unseen-domain evaluation.
historical_exposure: Phase 0, #48 and #58 tasks remain exposed regressions. New question IDs and focal resources do not relabel those cases. Archived corpora and some terminal/schema IRIs were previously public. GEMET focal concepts were outside the old 2200-concept extraction. Public evaluation is not a sealed holdout.
sealed_holdout: External 60-case Ask holdout excluded; no read, copy, edit, commitment change or scoring.
